text: In the village of Chandanghat, a lustful Thakur [rapes a young girl|wrong|sexual violation] who then kills herself, and the locals say [her vengeful spirit|threat|the restless dead] has since killed him and his son. Twenty years later his grandson Kumar arrives, scoffing at the warnings, and hears a woman singing from the swamp at night. When a man wearing Kumar's stolen coat dies [beneath the tree where Kumar's father and grandfather were killed|rules|tied to place or thing], Radha, a carefree village girl, begs him to leave before he [pays for his grandfather's crime|who_suffers|heirs of old wrongs].
